+import requests
+from requests.models import PreparedRequest
+
+def test_excess_slashes():
+    # Case 1: Single slash - should remain single slash
+    req1 = PreparedRequest()
+    req1.prepare_url("http://example.com/foo", None)
+    print(f"Case 1: {req1.url}")
+    assert req1.url == "http://example.com/foo"
+
+    # Case 2: Double slash - should be trimmed to single slash
+    req2 = PreparedRequest()
+    req2.prepare_url("http://example.com//foo", None)
+    print(f"Case 2: {req2.url}")
+    assert req2.url == "http://example.com/foo"
+
+    # Case 3: Triple slash - should be trimmed to single slash
+    req3 = PreparedRequest()
+    req3.prepare_url("http://example.com///foo", None)
+    print(f"Case 3: {req3.url}")
+    assert req3.url == "http://example.com/foo"
+
+    # Case 4: No path - should be /
+    req4 = PreparedRequest()
+    req4.prepare_url("http://example.com", None)
+    print(f"Case 4: {req4.url}")
+    assert req4.url == "http://example.com/"
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_excess_slashes()
+        print("All tests passed!")
+    except AssertionError as e:
+        print(f"Test failed!")
+        raise e
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
+        raise e
